createhp.warning.title: Warning: pressure system
createhp.warning.body:
Create: Industrial Pressure adds a pressure system to Create. Pipes, valves, tanks and turbines only hold a certain pressure.

• Create's pipes and tanks hold 16 bar, high pressure parts 256 bar, netherite parts 1,024 bar.
• Above its limit a part cracks and bursts. Netherite explodes and can destroy blocks around it.
• Pumps pushing into the same pipe add up their pressure.
• Engineer's Goggles show the pressure, Pressure Gauges pass it to Comparators. Regulators and relief valves keep it below the limit.

This notice appears only once.
